quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Passive voice: the app receives the action of being designed.
quests.explanation: Subject (The new app) + was designed (passive past) + to help people learn languages faster (purpose). Passive voice is used because the focus is on the app, not on who designed it.
quests.textToSpeak: The new app was designed to help people learn languages faster.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: 'That end up in the ocean' describes exactly which bottles.
quests.explanation: Subject (Plastic bottles) + that end up in the ocean (defining relative clause) + harm (verb) + marine life (object). The relative clause 'that...' specifies which bottles are meant.
quests.textToSpeak: Plastic bottles that end up in the ocean harm marine life.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Passive voice again: the subject receives the action rather than performing it.
quests.explanation: Subject (The vaccine) + was developed (passive past) + after years of careful medical research (time). Passive voice shifts focus onto the vaccine itself.
quests.textToSpeak: The vaccine was developed after years of careful medical research.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: 'Who overcame many obstacles' tells us more about the student.
quests.explanation: Subject (The scholarship) + was awarded (passive past) + to a student (recipient) + who overcame many obstacles (relative clause). 'Who' introduces relative clauses that describe people.
quests.textToSpeak: The scholarship was awarded to a student who overcame many obstacles.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: 'That used to be empty' contrasts with how the park is now.
quests.explanation: Subject (The park) + that used to be empty (relative clause) + is now full of families (main verb + complement). 'Used to be' describes a past state that has since changed.
quests.textToSpeak: The park that used to be empty is now full of families.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: 'By websites' shows who performs the passive action.
quests.explanation: Subject (Personal data) + is collected (passive present) + by websites (agent) + to improve user experience (purpose). 'By + agent' can be added to a passive sentence to show who does the action.
quests.textToSpeak: Personal data is collected by websites to improve user experience.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Passive voice with 'now' showing this is a current, ongoing trend.
quests.explanation: Subject (Solar panels) + are installed (passive present) + on rooftops across the entire city (place). 'Now' signals a recent, widespread change.
quests.textToSpeak: Solar panels are now installed on rooftops across the entire city.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: 'Who specializes in anxiety' identifies which therapist.
quests.explanation: Subject (The therapist) + who specializes in anxiety (relative clause) + has (verb) + a long waiting list (object). 'Specialize in' means to focus professionally on one particular area.
quests.textToSpeak: The therapist who specializes in anxiety has a long waiting list.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: The relative clause narrows 'students' down to a specific group.
quests.explanation: Subject (Students) + who struggle with math (relative clause) + often benefit from (verb phrase) + extra tutoring (object). 'Benefit from' means to gain something useful.
quests.textToSpeak: Students who struggle with math often benefit from extra tutoring.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: 'Thanks to' introduces the reason behind the passive event.
quests.explanation: Subject (The community center) + was renovated (passive past) + thanks to a generous local donation (reason). 'Thanks to' introduces a positive cause, similar to 'because of'.
quests.textToSpeak: The community center was renovated thanks to a generous local donation.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: 'Had frustrated' happened before the update, so it uses past perfect.
quests.explanation: Subject (The software update) + fixed (past tense) + several bugs (object) + that had frustrated users (relative clause). 'Had frustrated' (past perfect) shows the bugs existed before the fix.
quests.textToSpeak: The software update fixed several bugs that had frustrated users.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Start with 'Rivers'. The relative clause comes before the passive verb.
quests.explanation: Subject (Rivers) + that flow through the city (relative clause) + are monitored (passive present) + for pollution levels (purpose). The relative clause sits between the subject and its main verb.
quests.textToSpeak: Rivers that flow through the city are monitored for pollution levels.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Passive voice with a frequency adverb placed right after 'are'.
quests.explanation: Subject (Patients) + are usually advised (passive present + adverb) + to rest (infinitive) + after minor surgical procedures (time). 'Advised to + verb' is common in medical instructions.
quests.textToSpeak: Patients are usually advised to rest after minor surgical procedures.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: 'Who wrote the textbook' adds extra information about the professor.
quests.explanation: Subject (The professor) + who wrote the textbook (relative clause) + also teaches (verb) + the introductory course (object). 'Also' shows the professor has a second connection to the course.
quests.textToSpeak: The professor who wrote the textbook also teaches the introductory course.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Two passive verbs appear: 'are updated' and 'is released'.
quests.explanation: Subject (Smartphones) + are updated automatically (passive present) + whenever a new version is released (time clause, also passive). 'Whenever' means 'every time that'.
quests.textToSpeak: Smartphones are updated automatically whenever a new version is released.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: 'That burned last year' explains what happened to the forest.
quests.explanation: Subject (The forest) + that burned last year (relative clause) + is slowly beginning to recover (present continuous). 'Begin to + verb' marks the start of a gradual process.
quests.textToSpeak: The forest that burned last year is slowly beginning to recover.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: The relative clause defines exactly which volunteers are meant.
quests.explanation: Subject (Volunteers) + who sort donations (relative clause) + are always welcome (verb + adjective) + at the shelter (place). 'Welcome' here functions as an adjective, not a verb.
quests.textToSpeak: Volunteers who sort donations are always welcome at the shelter.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: 'Specifically' emphasizes the clear purpose behind the passive action.
quests.explanation: Subject (The clinic) + was built (passive past) + specifically to serve rural, underserved communities (purpose). 'Specifically' strengthens the stated purpose of an action.
quests.textToSpeak: The clinic was built specifically to serve rural, underserved communities.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Commas signal extra, non-essential information about the bridge.
quests.explanation: Subject (The bridge) + which was completed ahead of schedule (non-defining relative clause) + eased (verb) + daily traffic (object). Commas around 'which...' show the information adds detail but isn't essential to identify the bridge.
quests.textToSpeak: The bridge, which was completed ahead of schedule, eased daily traffic.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Again, commas mark an aside that could be removed without changing the core sentence.
quests.explanation: Subject (The report) + which surprised many doctors (non-defining relative clause) + linked (verb) + poor sleep to memory loss (object). Removing the clause between commas still leaves a complete sentence.
quests.textToSpeak: The report, which surprised many doctors, linked poor sleep to memory loss.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: 'Once' inside the aside signals a past state, contrasted with 'now'.
quests.explanation: Subject (The lake) + which was once polluted (non-defining relative clause) + now supports (verb) + a variety of fish (object). 'Once' means 'at an earlier time', contrasted here with 'now'.
quests.textToSpeak: The lake, which was once polluted, now supports a variety of fish.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: The aside gives background; the main clause gives the current fact.
quests.explanation: Subject (The library) + which reopened last month (non-defining relative clause) + now offers (verb) + free coding classes (object). The comma-separated clause adds background timing without being essential.
quests.textToSpeak: The library, which reopened last month, now offers free coding classes.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Inside the commas, the students are the ones doing the painting.
quests.explanation: Subject (The mural) + which local students painted (non-defining relative clause) + brightened (verb) + the entire street (object). Here 'which' is the object of 'painted', not the subject.
quests.textToSpeak: The mural, which local students painted, brightened the entire street.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: The passive clause in the middle describes the app's popularity.
quests.explanation: Subject (The app) + which was downloaded millions of times (non-defining relative clause, passive) + crashed (verb) + during the update (time). The middle clause explains popularity, not the cause of the crash.
quests.textToSpeak: The app, which was downloaded millions of times, crashed during the update.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: 'Is known to' is a passive pattern meaning 'people generally agree that'.
quests.explanation: Subject (Regular exercise) + is known to reduce (passive pattern) + stress and improve sleep quality (two joined objects). 'Known to + verb' reports a widely accepted fact.
quests.textToSpeak: Regular exercise is known to reduce stress and improve sleep quality.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: 'Are being built' shows the action is happening right now, not finished.
quests.explanation: Subject (Wind farms) + are being built (passive continuous) + along the coast (place) + to generate clean energy (purpose). Passive continuous describes an action in progress now.
quests.textToSpeak: Wind farms are being built along the coast to generate clean energy.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Passive continuous again — an ongoing change, not a finished one.
quests.explanation: Subject (The curriculum) + is being redesigned (passive continuous) + to include more practical skills (purpose). Use passive continuous for changes that are actively underway.
quests.textToSpeak: The curriculum is being redesigned to include more practical skills.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Two passive-style forms appear: 'is being stored' and 'located'.
quests.explanation: Subject (The company's data) + is being stored (passive continuous) + on servers located overseas (place, with a reduced relative clause 'that are located'). Reduced clauses drop 'that are' before a past participle.
quests.textToSpeak: The company's data is being stored on servers located overseas.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: The purpose clause explains why the lane is being added.
quests.explanation: Subject (A new bike lane) + is being added (passive continuous) + to reduce traffic accidents downtown (purpose). Passive continuous fits a visible, in-progress city project.
quests.textToSpeak: A new bike lane is being added to reduce traffic accidents downtown.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: 'Toward' shows the direction the funding is moving.
quests.explanation: Subject (More funding) + is being directed (passive continuous) + toward mental health services (destination) + nationwide (scope). 'Direct funding toward' means to allocate money to a specific purpose.
quests.textToSpeak: More funding is being directed toward mental health services nationwide.
